heading: Distinguish the controls
purpose: This sentence is about the opt-in that lets an account hold an issued token.
reader_must_understand: A trust line creates the holding relationship for an issued token. It is not an endorsement, not proof the token is safe, and not a promise the issuer will redeem it. The English wording to preserve is: Issuer authorization controls who may hold a currency when required. Individual freeze restricts spending through a trust line; deep freeze adds receiving restrictions, with issuer-direct exceptions. Global freeze has broader effects. These token controls do not freeze native XRP. Clawback is a separate capability and should be disclosed separately; it is not another name for freeze.
english: Issuer authorization controls who may hold a currency when required. Individual freeze restricts spending through a trust line; deep freeze adds receiving restrictions, with issuer-direct exceptions. Global freeze has broader effects. These token controls do not freeze native XRP. Clawback is a separate capability and should be disclosed separately; it is not another name for freeze.
translation: 발행자 승인(authorization)은 필요할 때 누가 통화를 보유할 수 있는지를 제어합니다. 개별 동결(individual freeze)은 트러스트 라인(trust line)을 통한 사용을 제한합니다. 딥 프리즈(deep freeze)는 받는 쪽 제한을 더하며, 발행자와 직접 거래하는 경우에는 예외가 있습니다. 글로벌 프리즈(global freeze)는 더 넓은 효과가 있습니다. 이 토큰 제어는 네이티브 XRP를 동결하지 않습니다. 클로백(clawback)은 별도 기능이므로 따로 공시해야 합니다. 동결의 다른 이름이 아닙니다.
